questions.q: Roughly what share of websites actually pass Google's page experience metrics on phones?
questions.quote: 48% of mobile origins and 56% of desktop origins had good Core Web Vitals

questions.q: Our site has about 3,000 pages. Should I be worried about how much of it Google bothers to crawl?
questions.quote: If the site has fewer than about 10,000 pages, ignore crawl budget

questions.q: I blocked some old pages in robots.txt to get them out of Google, but they still show up. Why?
questions.quote: They can stay indexed as bare URLs.

questions.q: Once I have the list of technical problems, how do I decide which ones to fix first?
questions.quote: Score each issue on four things, 1 to 3 each

questions.q: What does it mean when Search Console calls a page a soft 404?
questions.quote: is empty but returns a success code

questions.q: What click rate do Klaviyo stores usually get on automated emails compared with one-off sends?
questions.quote: campaign click rate 1.69% (top 10%: 3.38%); flow click rate 5.58%

questions.q: Our open rate shot up this month but clicks stayed flat. Did the new subject lines work?
questions.quote: If opens jump but clicks do not, assume privacy features, not interest

questions.q: Can we pack our order confirmation emails with promos and still treat them as non-marketing mail?
questions.quote: a receipt that is mostly promotion; under US law, mixed messages can count as commercial

questions.q: How many emails should a new-subscriber welcome series have, and spread over how many days?
questions.quote: Welcome (4 to 5 emails over about 10 to 14 days)

questions.q: When people talk about DMARC alignment, what actually has to line up?
questions.quote: the SPF or DKIM domain matches the domain in the visible From address

questions.q: What's a normal cost per lead for Facebook lead ads across all industries?
questions.quote: 8.54% conversion rate and 27.39 USD cost per lead

questions.q: One ad set is doing really well. Can I double its budget tonight and tweak the audience while I am at it?
questions.quote: make moderate steps and batch other edits together

questions.q: Retargeting looks like our best performer, yet pausing it didn't dent overall sales. What's going on?
questions.quote: Warm ad sets show high ROAS but total sales do not move when they pause

questions.q: How long should a new ad concept test run before I look at the results?
questions.quote: Minimum length: 7 days, to cover weekday patterns

questions.q: Is the 'cost per result goal' setting just the old cost cap under a new name?
questions.quote: Meta's current name for a cost cap

questions.q: How many years does a UK limited company need to hang on to its books and VAT paperwork?
questions.quote: UK company records; UK VAT records

questions.q: A supplier emailed saying they've switched banks. Can I just update their details and pay the next bill?
questions.quote: confirm by phone on a known number before the next payment

questions.q: How can I tell if a client's list of accounts has become too cluttered?
questions.quote: several accounts for the same thing, or accounts with one line all year

questions.q: How do I check whether a payment platform has quietly started charging us more?
questions.quote: total fees divided by gross sales, this period and last

questions.q: What does HMRC mean by a 'digital link'?
questions.quote: a digital transfer of data between software, required for Making Tax Digital

questions.q: What's a typical net revenue retention figure for a private B2B software company?
questions.quote: Median net / gross revenue retention, private B2B SaaS, 2025

questions.q: We report under FRS 102 and our new year started in 2026. What do I adjust before comparing this year's EBITDA with last year's budget?
questions.quote: restate last year's budget lines that hold rent before comparing EBITDA

questions.q: Is it bad practice to type growth rates straight into the formulas in a model?
questions.quote: move 1.07 to the inputs sheet with a label

questions.q: When I put unpaid invoices into the weekly cash forecast, which week should each one land in?
questions.quote: placed in the week each customer usually pays, not the due date

questions.q: What's the difference between bookings, billings and revenue?
questions.quote: what customers signed, what was invoiced and what the accounts recognise

questions.q: How big a fine could we face in the US for each cold email that breaks the rules?
questions.quote: Maximum US penalty per violating email, and per call after a do-not-call request

questions.q: Someone unsubscribed from our emails. Can we still call them or message them on LinkedIn?
questions.quote: suppress them everywhere the same day

questions.q: Is it fine to send our cold outreach from the same domain we use for billing and support?
questions.quote: Cold email sent from the domain that carries invoices and customer support

questions.q: I just booked a meeting. How long should my note to the closer be, and what goes in it?
questions.quote: Write a hand-off note of under 250 words

questions.q: Under PECR, what is a corporate subscriber?
questions.quote: a company or similar body; email to it needs no prior consent

questions.q: How long do we get to send evidence when a Stripe customer disputes a charge?
questions.quote: 7 to 21 days | Stripe dispute response window

questions.q: We just learned an order will ship a week late. Should we wait until the customer asks about it?
questions.quote: tell the customer before they ask and offer the choice to cancel

questions.q: A customer asked for a copy of their personal data weeks ago and it's still sitting with the other tickets. Is that a problem?
questions.quote: Data requests left in the general queue

questions.q: When shouldn't an agent use the standard 'where is my order' reply?
questions.quote: do not use if the order is more than 10 days late

questions.q: What does KCS stand for in support work?
questions.quote: Knowledge-Centered Service, capturing and improving knowledge as part of solving tickets

questions.q: How well does someone's years of experience actually predict how they'll perform?
questions.quote: Validity of years of job experience

questions.q: A candidate says someone from 'our company' asked them to pay for equipment before starting. What do we do?
questions.quote: treat it as a scam and warn the candidate

questions.q: How do I know our job ad has turned into a wish list?
questions.quote: ten bullet points of requirements, three of them years

questions.q: In the hiring debrief, which parts of the scorecards should we actually spend time discussing?
questions.quote: Discuss only the rows where scores differ by two or more points

questions.q: What's a correspondence or audit study in hiring research?
questions.quote: an experiment sending matched fictitious applications to measure discrimination

questions.q: What's the minimum weekly salary for a US role to count as exempt from overtime?
questions.quote: US federal exempt salary level from 15 May 2026

questions.q: Only three people on the warehouse team answered the staff survey. Can I show their results on their own?
questions.quote: merge it with another group or do not report it

questions.q: Two people in the same job at the same level earn very different amounts. Is that a red flag?
questions.quote: far apart in pay with no written reason

questions.q: Someone is leaving. How many exit conversation questions should I prepare, and what should they cover?
questions.quote: Draft 6 exit conversation questions that ask about the work

questions.q: What does calibration mean for an interview panel?
questions.quote: interviewers comparing scores on the same answer to align their standards

questions.q: If my endpoint keeps failing, how many times will Shopify retry a webhook before giving up on it?
questions.quote: Shopify webhook retries before the subscription is removed

questions.q: The API sent back a 400 because one field was wrong. Should my client retry it?
questions.quote: do not retry it, because it will fail the same way; fix the request

questions.q: We mark orders as paid when the customer lands on the thank-you page. Anything wrong with that?
questions.quote: the order is marked paid on the success page, not by the webhook

questions.q: When I review code that charges a card, what should I check about calls to outside services that time out?
questions.quote: The outside call times out but actually succeeded

questions.q: What is BOLA?
questions.quote: broken object level authorisation, OWASP API1

questions.q: What share of accessibility problems does an automated axe scan catch?
questions.quote: Share of WCAG issues axe finds automatically on average

questions.q: We are dropping some planned testing to hit the release date. What do I need to do about that?
questions.quote: write down what was cut, the risk, and who accepted it

questions.q: What kind of element selectors make browser tests break every time the styling changes?
questions.quote: long CSS class chains or nth-child selectors

questions.q: How do I decide which test cases are worth automating?
questions.quote: stable, repeated every release, and costly to run by hand

questions.q: What's an equivalence class in test design?
questions.quote: a group of inputs the system should treat the same

questions.q: How many hour-long moderated test sessions can I realistically fit into one day?
questions.quote: Most one-hour moderated sessions to run in a day

questions.q: The client's contract says the site must meet WCAG AA. Can I sign off that our design complies?
questions.quote: send the conformance question to the client's lawyer; do not certify compliance

questions.q: Is it OK if my test task tells people to go and find the page by its menu name?
questions.quote: the task text contains the menu label

questions.q: What should a form error message say?
questions.quote: what happened, why it matters (only if not obvious), and what to do next

questions.q: In tree test results, what does directness measure?
questions.quote: whether people went straight to the answer without backtracking

questions.q: What speed and accessibility scores does a theme need to get into Shopify's Theme Store?
questions.quote: average Lighthouse performance score of at least 60 and accessibility score of at least 90

questions.q: The shop team edits the homepage every day. What happens to their changes while I build on a copy of the theme?
questions.quote: agree a time to copy any content changes made on the live theme

questions.q: We've got two review widgets and a few pop-up apps installed. Is that a problem?
questions.quote: several apps doing overlapping jobs (two review widgets, three pop-ups)

questions.q: How do I estimate whether a particular speed fix is worth the effort?
questions.quote: Payback is sales at risk divided by effort

questions.q: What's drip pricing?
questions.quote: adding unavoidable charges later in the purchase

questions.q: At what headcount does a UK business have to write its risk assessment down?
questions.quote: UK employees at which risk assessment findings must be recorded

questions.q: One step in my procedure says 'check the order and print the label'. Is that fine as a single step?
questions.quote: Split any step with "and" in it into two.

questions.q: The same customer complaint has come up in our weekly meeting three weeks running. What are we doing wrong?
questions.quote: the same complaint in three weekly reviews

questions.q: When should staff follow a checklist line by line, and when can they work from memory and tick it off after?
questions.quote: read-do (follow line by line, for rare or risky tasks)

questions.q: What is takt time?
questions.quote: the pace of output needed to meet customer demand

questions.q: How long does a business have to answer a California resident who asks us to delete their data?
questions.quote: CCPA deadline to know, delete or correct

questions.q: We think someone got into our customer database last night. What should happen first?
questions.quote: start the incident log at once and alert the controller's decision makers

questions.q: We're grabbing screenshots of all our controls the week before the audit. Is that a problem?
questions.quote: screenshots all dated the same week for controls meant to run all year

questions.q: What goes in the one-page write-up at the end of reviewing a new software vendor?
questions.quote: what the tool does, data and risks found, contract flags

questions.q: What's a statement of applicability?
questions.quote: the ISO/IEC 27001 document listing which controls apply and why
